items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All five contract items: reason/note one line max 600 via the edited-line validator, org-wide decisions-rejected.md block under the decisions-proposed lock with header on create, audit data.reason string|null unchanged, no duplicate on retry, client reason (600) and note fields; grammar documented, fixture pinned.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unusable rejected file refused before any change (409 rejected_file_unwritable), post-check write errors mapped to the same 409 with the entry still listed; reason/note refusals are 400 with nothing written; symlink -> 403 via OrgSymlinkEscapeError.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Every text is normalizeLine'd to one line so nothing forges a header, marker or item; quote copies withheld from the org-wide file; reason/note quote guard; Reason item never taken from the lead-writable audit read-back; file not in the generic /file allowlist.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 16 server tests (exact block, header, crash orders, identity, 600/601, quote, unwritable, note line/whole/residue both branches, fixture pin), 4 client tests, e2e flow on the isolated stack; full suites green (server 5436, client 5367).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One linear parse of the rejected file per reject under the existing lock; no new polling, no extra request.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New writer isolated in decisions-rejected.ts (162 lines); validator reused (checkEditedLine with a max); all touched files under 300 lines (DecisionEntryRow 245).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer toRejectedBlock -> decisions-rejected.md -> parseRejectedBlocks round trip pinned byte-for-byte on the fixture (incl. a line starting with Reason:); countersign note -> decision_log.md -> parseLoggedLineBlock/residueKind round trip tested; leadwright decided-keys reads markers only, so the Note item is tolerated.
